title: Vaporesso DOJO Blast 2000 Go Strawberry Ice Prefilled Pod & Refill
description: Strawberry Ice from the Dojo Blast 2000 Go range delivers the juicy flavour of ripe Strawberries paired with a brisk Ice finish. The result is a sweet and fruity vape that adds an extra layer of icy refreshment with a subtle hit of menthol on the exhale. Ideal for vapers who enjoy simple yet satisfying fruit and ice flavour combinations. Each pack includes a transparent 2ml pod prefilled with 20mg nicotine salt e-liquid and a matching 2ml refill container, giving you up to 2,000 puffs of smooth MTL (mouth-to-lung) vaping with Vaporesso™s COREX 2.0 Mesh Coil for excellent flavour consistency. Simply snap the refill onto the pod, insert the assembled unit into your Dojo Blast 2000 Go device, and enjoy an easy, mess-free experience with clear visibility of your e-liquid levels thanks to the transparent pod design. How to Use: 1. Remove all packaging 2. Remove the red silicone covers from the base and top of the refill pod 3. Attach the 2ml pod to the 2ml refill 4. Insert the combined pod into the Dojo Blast device, twisting to secure 5. Inhale to vape—no buttons or setup required. 6. When finished, replace with a fresh pod+refill pack.
